concerns.text: The plan generates a synthetic `critical_cooling_rate` as a linear combination of the same thermodynamic descriptors that are later used as predictors (mixing_enthalpy, atomic_size_mismatch, electronegativity_variance). This makes the validation target definitionally dependent on the predictors, creating a circular/tautological evaluation: the model is guaranteed to perform well because the target was constructed from the features, not because the descriptors genuinely predict glass‑forming ability.
